[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Nancy was born in 1834. She was the daughter of [[Glasgow-193|James Glasgow]] and [[McNeil-3468|Mary McNeil]]. She passed away in 1902.
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-193]] is assessed at 92% (proved). Nancy Ann's 1834 birth and James/Mary McNeil attribution are tied to Faris p 85. The 1860 census and Corydon memorial support the Iowa descendant identity, though neither father field is quoted.

Selected Glasgow-193 fatherhood of Glasgow-2185; maternal identity and upstream ancestry are separate.
